package.name: l5_spiderbot
package.description: L5 sim-in-loop test for the spiderbot (roadmap 5.3, docs/notes/spiderbot-2026-11-11.md): racer_gym_bridge, the real racer_safety safety_node, racer_control's tracker on a patrol generated from waypoints, racer_apps' spiderbot_node and a fake detector that stands a synthetic person beside the track. The state machine is checked end to end: patrol, stop, face the person, alert, hold, resume. No library code: test hosting only (see .github/scripts/l5_spiderbot_test.sh).
